001package com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.intel.events.sd;
002
003import java.awt.Color;
004
005import com.fs.starfarer.api.Global;
006import com.fs.starfarer.api.campaign.econ.MarketAPI;
007import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.intel.events.BaseEventFactor;
008import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.intel.events.BaseEventIntel;
009import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.intel.events.BaseFactorTooltip;
010import com.fs.starfarer.api.ui.TooltipMakerAPI;
011import com.fs.starfarer.api.ui.TooltipMakerAPI.TooltipCreator;
012import com.fs.starfarer.api.util.Misc;
013
014public class SDRInsurgentACAFactor extends BaseEventFactor {
015        
016        protected MarketAPI market;
017
018        public SDRInsurgentACAFactor() {
019                this.market = Global.getSector().getEconomy().getMarket("nortia");
020        }
021
022        @Override
023        public boolean shouldShow(BaseEventIntel intel) {
024                return true;
025        }
026        
027        @Override
028        public TooltipCreator getMainRowTooltip(final BaseEventIntel intel) {
029                return new BaseFactorTooltip() {
030                        @Override
031                        public void createTooltip(TooltipMakerAPI tooltip, boolean expanded, Object tooltipParam) {
032                                Color h = Misc.getHighlightColor();
033                                tooltip.addPara("The Charterists (ACA) favor neither side of the Sindrian Diktat civil war, and opportunistically attack"
034                                                + " the forces of both Hector's absolutists and Achilles' reformers.", 0f, h, "Charterists");
035                                
036                                tooltip.addPara("The effect of Charterist resistance will hinder whichever heir appears to be winning the conflict.", 8f, h, "hinder");
037                                
038                                if(     Global.getSector().getMemoryWithoutUpdate().getBoolean("$anh_missionCompleted") && 
039                                        !Global.getSector().getMemoryWithoutUpdate().getBoolean("$anh_handedOverEveryone") && 
040                                        !Global.getSector().getMemoryWithoutUpdate().getBoolean("$anh_handedOverRobedMan")) {
041                                                
042                                        tooltip.addPara("A talented young pilot has led the ACA on several daring raids, freeing political prisoners from Cruor and infiltrating heavily-defended Diktat military installations. "
043                                                                + "This mop-haired youth has become a hero of the uprising; his image is shown throughout the Sector as a symbol of the cause.", 8f, h, "youth");
044                                        
045                                }
046                                // TODO: and if someone invades/destroys Nortia?
047                        
048                        }
049                };
050        }
051
052        @Override
053        public String getProgressStr(BaseEventIntel intel) {
054//              if (getProgress(intel) <= 0) return "";
055                return super.getProgressStr(intel);
056        }
057        
058        @Override
059        public int getProgress(BaseEventIntel intel) {
060                
061                int _multiplier = 0;
062                
063                if(Global.getSector().getMemoryWithoutUpdate().getBoolean("$sdse_playerGaveFuelACA")) _multiplier++;
064                if(Global.getSector().getMemoryWithoutUpdate().getBoolean("$sdse_playerGaveCreditsACA")) _multiplier++;
065                if(Global.getSector().getMemoryWithoutUpdate().getBoolean("$sdse_playerGaveSuppliesACA")) _multiplier++;
066                if(Global.getSector().getMemoryWithoutUpdate().getBoolean("$sdse_playerHelpedACAfinished")) _multiplier++;
067                if(Global.getSector().getMemoryWithoutUpdate().getBoolean("$sdr_arroyoAssistRebels")) _multiplier++;
068                if(Global.getSector().getMemoryWithoutUpdate().getBoolean("$sdr_horusBacksHegemony")) _multiplier++;
069                
070                if( Global.getSector().getMemoryWithoutUpdate().getBoolean("$anh_missionCompleted") &&
071                        !Global.getSector().getMemoryWithoutUpdate().getBoolean("$anh_handedOverEveryone") && 
072                        !Global.getSector().getMemoryWithoutUpdate().getBoolean("$anh_handedOverRobedMan")) {
073                        
074                        _multiplier++;
075                }
076                        
077                // negative for Hector, positive for Achilles.
078                // Who is winning?
079                if(SDResolution.get() != null) { 
080                        if(SDResolution.get().getProgress() > SDResolution.ACHILLES / 2) {
081                                return SDRPoints.ACA_BASE + SDRPoints.ACA_EFFECT * -_multiplier;
082                        }
083                        else {
084                                return SDRPoints.ACA_BASE + SDRPoints.ACA_EFFECT * _multiplier;
085                        }
086                }
087                
088                return 0;
089        }
090
091        @Override
092        public String getDesc(BaseEventIntel intel) {
093                return "Charterist raiding in Askonia";
094        }
095        
096        @Override
097        public Color getDescColor(BaseEventIntel intel) {
098                if (getProgress(intel) != 0) return Misc.getTextColor();
099                return Misc.getGrayColor();
100        }
101
102        
103}
